description: มุน 2026-07-31 (ดวงสมพงศ์ ก้อน 2F — จอรอครอบช่วงคำนวณ). Bug ฟีม hit: กดปุ่ม → ปุ่มค้าง "กำลังคำนวณ…" นาน → จอรอเด้งแวบเดียวแล้วหาย. Root (บอง opened the code): the LoadingScreen was hung on the WRONG screen — the heavy calculateCompatibility (side-effect: log + quota) runs on the FORM (CompatibilityScreen) but the loader only covered the fast result-read (CompatibilityResultScreen), so the real wait showed as a spinner LABEL on the button and the full-screen loader only flashed on the already-finished result. 2nd AMEND of D17 (plan error, not μุน). Bug-class run-compat-2f owns (visual/presentation + behavioural fire-once): (a) D30 — while calculating, the form early-returns the full-screen LoadingScreen (role=status) so the wait shows where the work is; asserted role=status UP + [data-testid=compat-screen] count 0 during the 900ms-mocked calc. (b) D31 — the button carries NO loading state, label always "ดูผลลัพธ์เลย", never "กำลังคำนวณ…"; also asserts the button PAINTS enabled sapphire rgb(20,85,164) after transition-colors settles (not a gray mid-transition frame). (c) D32/D35 — form-phase and result-phase loaders render the SAME ฟีม-verbatim copy from ONE source compat-loading-copy.ts, seamless client-nav swap, no white flash. (d) D33 — the calc still fires from the form ONCE, hardened with a firingRef latch (a calculating state var alone is racy: a synchronous double-tap re-enters onViewResult with a stale closure and fires the quota-consuming call 5x); proven by a 5x synchronous $eval tap → POST /user-matching count 1. (e) D34 — calc failure → back on the FORM with compat-result-error, latch released, NOT stranded on the loader. run-compat-2f.ts drives the REAL CompatibilityScreen through the real select-friend modal, mocking only v1/BE HTTP (no BE/quota). Golden-rule-6 surgery proof: the not-pressed form renders 0/1339344 = 0.0000% (byte-identical) before(origin/main)/after. D36 real press→result timing SURFACED to บอง (cannot fabricate a real-data number from the UI worktree — mock delays are artificial; real bazi timing needs a BE/quota run). Tooth: mut-loader-on-result-only (delete the form early-return loader = revert to the shipped bug) → D30 loader-covers-the-FORM check CAUGHT; negative-controls hit live (Promise.all-click false-negative → $eval; button mid-transition gray frame → settle+assert). NO pages/matching or api-user-matching edited (git diff = 0). gate_layer=visual/loader-on-form+D31-no-button-spinner+D32-copy-continuity+D33-fire-once+D34-error-returns. REV2 (ตู๋ Request-Changes round): the "calc throws → stuck loader" claim is a miss (calculateCompatibility is fully try/caught, cannot throw — no fake armour added); the REAL hole was the un-awaited router.push — if the nav rejects/cancels or resolves false, calculating+firingRef never release → loader stranded. Fixed: await push in try/catch, treat reject OR !navigated as failure → release+form+error (same recovery block as D34); success path touches no state (no setState-after-unmount console noise — design-verify.yml gates on it). New teeth/checks: D34b (push reject & push false, forced by stubbing push on Next singleton window.next.router — deterministic, no nav) + tooth mut-unhandled-push (revert to bare push → D34b strands → CAUGHT); console WARNINGS now captured too (=0). D32 continuity downgraded honestly: a still screenshot cannot prove no-flash; proven instead = identical loader component+copy (no copy swap) + an rAF frame-level trace across the same-document handoff (blankFrames=0), with the stated caveat that a sub-~16ms/sub-frame flash is below the trace resolution. Baseline now 16/16.
